note: Plant sets for the V2 digital twin. SIMULATION ONLY. Set A is what the controller is DESIGNED on; B and C are only to GRADE (see doc/THERMAL_V2_CONSTANTS.md section 6). Units: Pmax W, Cf/Ce J/C, hA/UA W/C, td/tl s. Parameter ranges come from doc/THERMAL_REDESIGN_RESEARCH.md and doc/SLOW_OVEN_STUDY.md; A4 is derived from the owner's 15/10 log (hold 1.9 % of 16 kW, Kh 0.0133 C/s, theta 150+50 s).

B.prng: xorshift32: x^=x<<13; x^=x>>17; x^=x<<5 (uint32), u=x/2^32, draws in the order listed, one plant after another
B.rule: uniform in each range; reject and redraw when held SP 37.5 would need > 90 % of Pmax at Te=SP, Tamb 28 (UA*9.5/Pmax > 0.9)

modifiers.what: third thermal mass: extra slow node Cs=1.5 MJ/C coupled by 400 W/C to the air
sensor lag +20 s (first-order) in addition to the production filter
heater gain -30 % (element derate / ageing), the controller is not told
egg coupling hA changes with the circulation fan: x0.6 for 20 min every 2 h
supply sag: Pmax*(1-0.12*duty_60s) and a 5 % step at hour 3
calibration offset -0.5 C on the sensor (controller sees PV-0.5), 0.1 C quantisation

scenarios.S1: first batch from 33 C, eggs at 33 C
scenarios.S2: first batch from 28 C, eggs at 28 C
scenarios.S3: restart: air 33 C, eggs 37 C (power loss / second batch)
scenarios.S4: door opens at settled state: air -3 C step at t0
scenarios.S5: cold tray: 25 % and 50 % of egg mass at 28 C inserted into a settled oven
scenarios.S6: vent fan 2.5 kW for 5 min, scheduled (known in advance) and unscheduled
scenarios.S7: 24 h: embryo heat 0->1500 W ramp, ambient 28->20 C swing, supply sag
scenarios.S9: permit lost 10 min (sensor lost / contactor open) then returned
scenarios.S10: protection loop (G4): full-power request with sensor faults / SSR stuck

D.note: DEVELOPMENT set (G3c): same generator and ranges as B, different seed. Tuning is allowed on A and D; B and C only grade.
